entries.summary: Migrated features from old React frontend to new vanilla JS frontend. Added search, filters, pagination, dashboard, notifications, products, cart, and more.
entries.details: Enhanced frontend-v2 with features from old React app: 1) Courses page with search, category/level/sort filters, pagination. 2) CourseDetail with tabs, lesson completion, sidebar with links. 3) Search overlay in navbar. 4) Notifications view. 5) My Courses view. 6) Dashboard with stats. 7) Home page with hero + featured courses. 8) Products and Product Detail views. 9) Cart view. 10) Improved CSS with level badges, back links, meta rows.
